base: black-and-white editorial fine-art photograph, desaturated, high contrast, fine film grain. SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio. Minimal still-life composition, like a museum object photograph. The ENTIRE UPPER HALF of the image is a plain, smooth, light plaster wall, bright and empty, fading to near-white at the top edge for clean compositing. Subject small and dark, resting on a surface in the lower half of the frame, nothing entering from above. No text, no words, no logos, no gradients, no added color, no stock photo look, no clutter, no people, no face.

images.scene: On a bare tiled floor against the plain plaster wall: ONE pair of running shoes just taken off, soaked and muddy from a run in the rain before dawn, laces loose, left side by side near the wall. Small, in the lower third of the frame. Nothing else. Dim early-morning light from the side, long shadow.

On a bare wooden table against the plain plaster wall, seen at table level: ONE small desk lamp switched on, its warm cone of light falling on an open notebook with handwritten pages and a pen, late at night, everything else dark. The lamp is short and stays well below the middle of the frame. Nothing else. No other light source.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: a row of four empty folding chairs lined up facing the camera, as if an audience had never come. The chairs are low and small, in the lower third of the frame. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadows.
